name: perfectPixel
description: Refine and quantize messy AI pixel art into clean, perfect pixels.
readme_summary: Perfect Pixel is a Python tool designed to automatically detect and refine AI-generated pixel art. It corrects distorted grids and ensures perfectly aligned pixels, making messy pixel art clean and usable.
key_features: Automatically detect grid size from pixel style images
Refines AI generated pixel style image to perfectly aligned grids
Easy to integrate into your own workflow
Provides both OpenCV and Lightweight (NumPy only) implementations
Offers a ComfyUI custom node for workflow integration
primary_use_case: To clean up and perfect AI-generated pixel art by automatically detecting and correcting distorted grids and pixel alignment.
cover_image_prompt: A meticulous digital artisan, akin to a jeweler, carefully polishing and aligning scattered, rough-cut gemstones into a perfectly ordered mosaic. The input gemstones are chaotic and misaligned, representing messy AI pixel art. The artisan uses glowing digital tools to precisely place each gem, transforming the input into a flawless, sharp-edged pixel art pattern. Subtle UI elements showing grid lines and pixel counts are visible on a nearby holographic display. The scene is set in a clean, futuristic workshop with soft, focused lighting, emphasizing precision and transformation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant colors and clear visual contrast between the chaotic input and the perfect output.

name: vigil-tui
description: Real-time terminal power monitor — CPU · GPU · RAM wattage dashboard  Visibility
readme_summary: Vigil-tui is a real-time terminal dashboard for monitoring hardware power consumption, thermals, and performance metrics. It provides detailed insights into CPU, GPU, and RAM usage, along with process-level power estimation and cost analysis, all within a single command-line interface.
key_features: Real-time wattage, thermals, clock speeds, and electricity cost monitoring for CPU, GPU, and RAM
Power and clock history charts (Braille area chart)
Cross-platform support (Linux, Windows, macOS) with specific sensor integrations
primary_use_case: Monitoring and analyzing real-time hardware power consumption and performance metrics directly within the terminal.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant, stylized digital guardian standing watch over a glowing, intricate circuit board representing a computer's core components (CPU, GPU, RAM). The guardian holds a transparent tablet displaying real-time power readings and historical graphs in a Braille-like pattern. Subtle streams of energy flow from the components to the guardian's tablet, visualizing power consumption and cost. Small, glowing icons indicate thermal status and clock speeds. The background is a dark, futuristic terminal interface with the 'vigil-tui' name subtly integrated into the scene. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a cyberpunk aesthetic, emphasizing data flow and real-time monitoring.

name: homebox
description: A continuation of HomeBox the inventory and organization system built for the Home User
readme_summary: HomeBox is a Go-based inventory and organization system designed for home users, prioritizing simplicity, speed, and portability. It offers features like categorization, powerful search, image uploads, and document tracking, all accessible via an embedded web UI and deployable with minimal resources.
key_features: Rich Organization (categories, locations, tags, custom fields)
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot assistant meticulously organizing a vast collection of diverse household items (books, tools, electronics, furniture) into clearly labeled digital shelves within a cozy, modern home environment. The robot is shown scanning an item with a subtle beam of light, which then instantly appears on a corresponding digital shelf with its details displayed on a small, integrated holographic screen. The overall scene is bright and clean, emphasizing ease of use and comprehensive cataloging. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm color palette, conveying a sense of order and accessibility.

name: ya-music-desktop
description: Desktop client for Yandex Music with download button
readme_summary: YaMusic Desktop Client is a JavaScript-based desktop application that provides a wrapper around the Yandex Music web interface. It enhances the user experience by adding a download button for tracks, albums, and playlists, while also blocking ads and preserving user sessions.
key_features: Download music (tracks, albums, playlists) directly from the interface
Uses pywebview and Edge WebView2 for a desktop window
Downloads music in MP3 format (320/192/128 kbps) via yandex-music library
Applies ID3 tags and embeds cover art using mutagen
Blocks ads and automatically accepts cookie banners
primary_use_case: To provide a desktop client for Yandex Music that allows users to download music and enhances the listening experience by blocking ads.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, friendly robot with a music note emblem on its chest, holding a digital 'download' arrow pointing towards a stack of vinyl records and digital music files. The robot is standing in front of a glowing, stylized Yandex Music web interface window. Subtle digital particles representing music flow from the interface to the robot's hand. The background is a clean, modern studio with soft, ambient lighting. The overall mood is helpful and efficient. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant colors and clear, friendly character design.

name: shok-monitor
description: Agentless SOC & GRC platform — monitoring, 39 DBs, threat intel over SSH. Windows desktop app.
readme_summary: SHOK is a Windows desktop application that provides agentless Security Operations Center (SOC) and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) capabilities. It monitors infrastructure, databases, and performs vulnerability analysis and threat intelligence gathering solely over SSH, without installing any agents on remote systems.
key_features: Infrastructure monitoring (hosts, Docker, networks, live traffic)
Vulnerability and exposure scanning with remediation
Compliance and audit reporting (CIS, NIST, ISO)
primary_use_case: To provide a comprehensive, agentless SOC and GRC platform for monitoring and securing IT infrastructure through SSH.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled cartographer in a dimly lit study, using an antique spyglass to map a vast, interconnected network of glowing nodes and pathways representing IT infrastructure. The spyglass reveals hidden vulnerabilities as red sparks and security threats as shadowy figures within the network. On the desk, a partially drawn map displays compliance standards like CIS and NIST, with data streams flowing from the spyglass to update the map. Subtle UI elements of SHOK are visible on a nearby monitor, showing live traffic and database queries. The scene is rendered in a detailed, vintage digital painting style with a focus on rich textures and dramatic lighting, emphasizing discovery and control.

name: DracoLure
description: DracoLure — Dragon Vector Honeypot: polyglot deception honeypot with real-time detection, threat scoring, and quarantine.
readme_summary: DracoLure is a sophisticated Dragon Vector Honeypot designed to deceive, detect, score, and quarantine malicious network traffic in real-time. It serves believable bait to attackers, analyzes incoming requests against a signature library, assigns threat scores, and automatically blocks hostile sources.
key_features: Automatic quarantine and blocking of hostile sources
Serves believable bait (fake corporate portal, /.env, wp-login, etc.)
Integration with Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring
REST API and Python SDK for interaction
primary_use_case: To act as a deceptive honeypot that lures, detects, and mitigates cyber threats by analyzing and quarantining malicious network probes.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant dragon guarding a treasure hoard, but the treasure is a series of tempting, glowing digital doors labeled with common web vulnerabilities like '/.env' and 'wp-login'. The dragon breathes a stream of data that analyzes incoming shadowy figures (attackers) approaching the doors. Figures that are identified as malicious are caught in a shimmering net of quarantine, while benign visitors are allowed to pass. Small, subtle UI elements showing threat scores and quarantine status float around the scene. The overall mood is one of active defense and intelligent monitoring. The art style should be a detailed digital painting with a dark, mystical atmosphere, emphasizing the dragon's protective role and the digital nature of the threats.
